content_sections.heading: District Project Livelihood College Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. ESTB/3017/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download District Project Livelihood College notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma/ITI (Mechanical/Electronics/Electrical) with 1 year industrial and 1 year training experience in Solar Panel Installation, or certified in relevant CITS Trade Experience: 1 year industrial and 1 year training experience in the field of Solar Panel Installation Other conditions: No reservation rules apply to this recruitment. Government, semi-government or private organisation experience is accepted. Mention phone/mobile number and email ID in the application. Desirable: Candidates with ToT-Domain Certification and Platform Certification/CTI/CITS get preference.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for District Project Livelihood College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without the required equivalent experience. Candidates arriving more than two hours after the stated interview time are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: District Project Livelihood College Solar Panel Installation Technician Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct continuous training for trainees enrolled in the Solar Panel Installation Technician course as per the target set by the state office. Perform community mobilization and counseling of trainees. Ensure placement of trainees within 03 months after training completion. Maintain attendance, continuous training records, and document verification as scheduled.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is purely temporary, for up to 12 months, and may be extended based on performance. Selected candidate must join within 7 days of the selection notice. Selected candidate without ToT certification must obtain it at own cost within 1 month of selection. Engagement may end if the training sector does not run or if work is unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How Will District Project Livelihood College Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection on merit by selection committee Selection is by interview, on a merit basis, by the selection committee. Experience given by the candidate will be verified.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original educational and technical qualification documents with 2 self-attested copies Experience certificate Proof of age Registration and attested documents as prescribed ToT/CTI/CITS certificate, if held Aadhaar card number and employment office registration number in the form

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Project Livelihood College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear in person for the walk-in interview on 04-11-2026 at District Project Livelihood College, Nakti Semra, Adawal, Jagdalpur. Registration and document verification from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM; interview from 1:30 PM. Bring the filled application form (given in the notice), full biodata and all required documents. Carry original documents and 2 self-attested photocopies of each.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selection list will be shown on the office notice board and on www.bastar.gov.in. Course list and details are available at cssda.cg.nic.in and www.bastar.gov.in. Selected trainer must complete mobilisation, counselling and placement of trainees within 3 months after training.
